title: Very deceptive
text: Very deceptive. So the picture shows you six hundred magnets, which is deceptive. The listing actually comes with one hundred magnets, however, when I got mine, I only got sixty. The listing was changed to sixty, but that was after I got mine, expecting one hundred. A poor price for how very few you end up getting.
